The estimate rests on two things I recall, not on a filed full-year number:
- Fiscal 2025 merchandise costs were roughly $239.9 billion.
- Net sales grew about 8–9% in the first two quarters of fiscal 2026, and merchandise costs have been tracking sales closely, with gross margin edging up slightly.

That implies fiscal 2026 merchandise costs of roughly $259 billion.
